title: Input-head bit in the configuration code
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine with Boolean tape symbols, let $n,s\in\mathbb{N}$, let $x$ be a Boolean input, and let $c$ be a configuration of $M$ on input $x$. For every $j<n+2$, the bit of the code at position $n+j$ is true exactly when the input-head position of $c$ is $j$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite Turing machine $M$ with Boolean symbols
